candidates.source_name: Prozorro — official public procurement portal (tender search)
candidates.why_relevant: Primary Ukrainian e-procurement portal where all state and state-owned-bank tenders are published. Tender texts and technical specifications for ATMs (банкомати), POS terminals (POS-термінали/платіжні термінали), cash-in-transit (інкасація) and card processing expose fleet counts, unit volumes, service scopes, incumbents and unit prices that no NBU statistical release contains.
candidates.access_status: open, no registration required for viewing
candidates.legal_status: public information published under Law of Ukraine 'On Public Procurement'; open data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OpenProcurement API over HTML scraping; use portal UI/CPV filters to build the query vocabulary, then pull structured tender objects via API.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from analytics articles

закупівля інкасація готівки тендер Prozorro банк POS-термінали процесинг

candidates.source_name: OpenProcurement / Prozorro public API (Central Database, ЦБД)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable feed of every tender, award, contract and document in Prozorro since 2015, built on Open Contracting Data Standard. This is the industrial-scale collection route for ATM/POS/cash-handling/processing procurement records, enabling CPV-code and full-text filtering plus longitudinal price and volume series.
candidates.access_status: open API, no key needed for public read endpoint (per documentation)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Incremental crawl of the paged /tenders feed keyed on dateModified, storing raw JSON; then filter by CPV codes (30123600 cash dispensers, 30142000 accounting/POS machines, 66xxx financial services, 79710000 security/CIT) and Ukrainian keyword regexes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: targeted search for API/open-data entry point
queries_used: Prozorro API openprocurement public data ЦБД відкриті дані закупівлі

candidates.source_name: BI Prozorro — public analytics module (Qlik Sense)
candidates.why_relevant: Free Qlik-based analytics over all Prozorro procurement since 2015. Lets an analyst cut spend by CPV, buyer (e.g. Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, NBU) and supplier, derive market prices for ATM servicing or terminal supply, and size the addressable public/state-bank market without building an ETL pipeline first.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/assisted analyst use for scoping and cross-checks; Qlik front-end is unfriendly to scraping, so treat as a validation layer over API-collected data. Export to XLSX where the UI allows.
queries_used: bi.prozorro.org аналітика закупівель модуль

candidates.source_name: BI PRO Prozorro — professional analytics module
candidates.why_relevant: Extended (paid/registered) analytics tier with deeper cuts than the public module — supplier-level competitive analysis, disqualification and price-dynamics views useful for profiling ATM/POS incumbents and Printec-adjacent competitors in Ukraine.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate subscription terms before use; analyst-driven queries and exports rather than automated collection.
queries_used: bi.prozorro.org аналітика закупівель модуль

candidates.source_name: Prozorro Infobox — procurement knowledge base
candidates.why_relevant: Official explanatory base for how Prozorro procedures, e-catalogues, analytics modules and monitoring work. negative_findings.description: Searches combining cash-in-transit, POS terminals and processing in one Ukrainian query returned no single consolidated tender or index; only a specific CIT tender (UA-2021-08-17-006384-a, 'Послуги інкасації та перевезення валютних цінностей') and generic portal pages surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Composite topic queries do not map to a composite source; the topics must be pursued as separate CPV/keyword streams inside Prozorro.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not expect a ready-made 'payments procurement' index; it must be built from CPV plus Ukrainian keyword filters over the raw API.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm via search that Prozorro Market's e-catalogue actually carries CPV 30123600 (cash dispensers / автомати для видачі готівки) or payment-terminal product cards.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only general Prozorro Market documentation was returned; no product-level evidence for ATM or POS categories.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The e-catalogue's usefulness for hardware price benchmarking is a hypothesis until a human checks the CPV tree on the platform itself.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated TED view or filter specifically indexing Ukraine-directed payment/banking-equipment tenders was found via search; only a generic Denmark/EUACI IT-equipment framework example surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED coverage of Ukraine payment hardware must be established by running CPV plus country filters directly on TED, not from a pre-existing index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations: TED is a low-yield but high-credibility stream for this cell, requiring its own query engineering.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language donor-procurement aggregator was found that consolidates EBRD/UNDP/World Bank Ukraine notices; donor procurement appears only in English-language portals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search terms for donor procurement returned domestic Prozorro platforms rather than donor indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Donor-funded stream must be collected in English; local-language monitoring will systematically miss it.

negative_findings.description: Clarity Project restricted free access to extended Prozorro analytics (reported January 2024); subscription pricing reported roughly UAH 450/day to UAH 33,000/year.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep supplier/competitor analytics on this platform now carries a cost; the free tier is limited.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and licensing must be planned if Clarity is to be part of the standing collection stack; otherwise fall back to the free Prozorro API plus BI module.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified CPV code list for ATM, POS/payment terminal, self-service kiosk, cash-processing and card-processing procurement in the Ukrainian classifier (ДК 021:2015).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and validate a CPV crosswalk (candidate roots: 30123600 cash dispensers, 30142000 accounting/cash machines, 302xxxxx office/computing equipment, 48xxxxxx software, 66xxxxxx financial services, 79710000 security/CIT) against actual Prozorro tender data before running production filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Private commercial banks and non-bank PSPs (e.g. Raiffeisen, Universal/monobank, FUIB, PUMB, OTP, and independent ATM/terminal operators) are not subject to Prozorro and are largely absent from this cell's sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend into the commercial-tender sections of accredited marketplaces and into vendor-side announcements; flag the private-bank fleet as a blind spot to be covered by other cells (regulatory/NBU statistics, vendor press).

coverage_gaps.description: Contract-level documents (tender documentation, technical specifications, award protocols, signed contracts as attachments) were not individually assessed — only the portals that host them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pilot a document-harvest pass on 10-20 known ATM/CIT tenders to establish attachment formats, OCR needs and how often unit counts and prices are actually disclosed.

coverage_gaps.description: World Bank (UN Development Business / STEP), USAID and EU delegation procurement for Ukraine were not searched in this slice; only EBRD, UNDP/UNGM and TED were covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second donor sweep covering World Bank procurement notices, USAID/Grants.gov and EU funding-and-tenders portal filtered on Ukraine financial-sector projects.

coverage_gaps.description: Several URLs (bipro.prozorro.org, dasu.gov.ua, prozorro.gov.ua/ProzorroMarket, tender.privatbank.ua) were recorded from search results and reasoning rather than fetched; access status and exact paths are unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass confirm; re-derive canonical URLs for any that redirect or 404.

brief: Ukraine's procurement layer is unusually rich for payments intelligence because Prozorro is legally mandatory, fully open and API-accessible, and because the three largest ATM/card operators (PrivatBank, Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank) plus Ukreximbank and the NBU are all state-sector buyers whose tender texts disclose fleet sizes, service scopes, incumbents and unit prices. The collection backbone should be the OpenProcurement public API (raw, free, OCDS-based) with BI Prozorro for scoping and Spending/Є-Data for payment validation, while Clarity Project and Opendatabot serve as licensed shortcuts for supplier and counterparty profiling. Supranational and donor channels (TED, EBRD ECEPP, UNDP/UNGM) add a smaller but high-credibility stream of Ukraine-directed equipment and advisory contracts, and are English-only. The principal blind spots are private banks and non-bank terminal operators, which never enter Prozorro, and the absence of a verified CPV taxonomy for ATM/POS/cash-handling categories — both must be closed before any market sizing is attempted from this cell.
